The '''decoy glowrod''' was a piece of equipment used by enemies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] alike. It was a fully functional [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] with a hollowed-out handle, that could be used to hide small objects&mdash;from [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] and [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] to [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]] and small [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]]. Since the glowrod was fully functional, Imperial agents almost never suspected that the device could also carry contraband.
